# Selected pixelfx sources

Source: https://github.com/patch-gg/pixelfx
Commit: a84159688af3ca37a4be05a0d422b94451b2e24e
License: MIT; see LICENSE and NOTICE.md, including Hugo Duprez attribution.
Only core, two effects, helpers, and PNG encoder are vendored. No gallery font.
`npm run assets:fx` exports game-ready frames; the browser does not run the simulator.
